personality: 7 Dark-First Utility structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A premium, nocturnal command center where elegant glass surfaces meet high-density financial and operational utility.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for luxury feel, but dense financial cards to minimize scroll. Strict 8-point grid rhythm.

do's: Use frosted glass (backdrop-blur-lg) over dark image backgrounds for hero cards and sticky headers.
Apply glass to bottom tab bar and bottom-sheet headers.
Use a translucent tinted base (≥75% of surface) underneath glass to guarantee text contrast.
dont's: Never apply glass to form fields or standard list rows.
Do not stack more than 2 glass surfaces on one screen.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Simple email/password login tailored for the event organizer.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a dark gradient scrim (top to bottom fade). The login form sits in the bottom 40% inside a glass-morphic sheet (translucent background, large blur). Large typography, minimal inputs.

screens.name: Kalendarz
screens.purpose: Monthly view of events with quick-glance dots and a scrolling list of upcoming shifts/events.

states.empty: Elegant desk background illustration with 'Brak wydarzeń w tym miesiącu' (No events this month).

screens.layout: Sticky glass header. Top half: Monthly calendar grid. Days with events have a small gold dot. Bottom half: Scrollable list of events for the selected day. Each list item is a card (surfaceSecondary) with the event name, time, and quick revenue snippet. Uses a 'micro-to-macro' toggle concept where selecting a day filters the list below.

screens.name: Imprezy
screens.purpose: List of past and upcoming events with a Create Event FAB.

states.empty: Empty stage background with 'Nie masz jeszcze żadnych imprez' (You don't have any events yet).

screens.layout: Scrolling list of events. High-contrast cards with hero images for each event. Images have a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text readability. FAB (Floating Action Button) with glass effect pinned at the bottom right for creating a new event.

screens.name: Impreza Detail (Modal/Sheet)
screens.purpose: Edit event details, log revenue, assign staff, and auto-calculate profit.
screens.layout: Sticky header with Save CTA. Tabbed or sectional layout: 1. Event Info (Date, Venue), 2. Financials (Revenue input, Costs breakdown), 3. Staffing (Assign staff, input hours). Auto-calculates Labor Cost = Staff Hours * Rate. Sticky bottom 'Save' CTA.

screens.name: Pracownicy
screens.purpose: Manage the list of staff, roles, and hourly rates.
screens.layout: Simple, functional list. Each row contains an avatar (initials inside a brandTertiary circle), Name, Role, and their hourly rate (PLN/h). Add button sticky at bottom.

screens.name: Statystyki
screens.purpose: Monthly financial dashboard showing revenue, costs, and profit.

states.empty: No financial data for this period.

screens.layout: Command-center style. Large 'Barlow Condensed' typography for the main 'Całkowity Zysk' (Total Profit) metric at the top. 2-column grid for 'Przychody' (Revenue) and 'Koszty' (Costs) cards using success and error colors minimally. Export to CSV/PDF secondary button. Bar chart or breakdown list below.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is in Polish as requested. Use PLN for currency formatting (e.g., '1 250 PLN').
Follow the Glass/Luxe aesthetic: Deep charcoal backgrounds with Antique Gold accents. Avoid blue/purple entirely.
Implement the 'micro-to-macro' calendar layout: A monthly grid view that takes the top half, with a scrollable list of events below it.
For financial stats, use Barlow Condensed for the large metric numbers to give a command-center utility feel.
Ensure every image card (like in the Imprezy list) uses the required gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to keep text readable.
Implement auto-calculation in the Event Detail screen: Profit = Revenue - Costs - (Sum of Staff Hours * Hourly Rate).
Use Phosphor icons. Keep weights consistent (e.g., regular).
Staff avatars should fallback to initials in a brandTertiary circle.
Keep touch targets >= 44x44pt. Include safe area margins for all screens.
